mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_job (checkpoint_date, corporate_number) SELECT checkpoint_date, corporate_number FROM company_entry ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH claimed AS ( SELECT corporate_number FROM export_job WHERE status = 'pending' and checkpoint_date = #{checkpointDate} LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE export_job SET status = 'processing', claimed_by = #{instanceId}, claimed_at = now() FROM claimed WHERE export_job.corporate_number = claimed.corporate_number RETURNING export_job.corporate_number
mapper.update: UPDATE export_job SET status = 'done', completed_at = now() WHERE corporate_number = #{corporateNumber}
